title: Reflections from Research Roundtables at the Conference on Health, Inference, and Learning (CHIL) 2025

bias_targets.methodology: The paper summarizes roundtable discussions recommending the evaluation of AI fairness by measuring subpopulation performance on disaggregated demographic groups, as well as addressing biases in data-generating processes and phenotyping that alter cohort demographics.

The authors discuss the conceptual need to evaluate the fairness and generalizability of AI interventions in rural and under-resourced health settings, contrasting them with models traditionally developed at large urban academic health centers.
